core.sign-in.page.title: Sign in
core.sign-in.page.open-sign-up: New here? Signing in with your email creates your account.
core.sign-in.page.no-way-in: This address cannot sign in here. Try another address, or sign in with a passkey.
core.sign-in.page.sent: If {address} can sign in here, we have sent it a link and a six-digit code. The link works in this browser; the code works anywhere.
core.sign-in.page.error.provider-unverif: {provider} has not confirmed this account's email address. Confirm it with {provider}, or sign in another way.
core.sign-in.page.error.provider-domain: That {provider} account is not from an organisation that can sign in here. Choose another account.
core.sign-in.page.error.closed: This theatre is not taking new accounts at the moment.
core.sign-in.page.error.disabled: This account is disabled. Contact the theatre to find out why.
core.sign-in.page.error.provider-other: {provider} did not confirm who you are. Try again.
core.sign-in.page.error.provider-managed: Addresses at that domain sign in another way. Enter your address below to see how.
core.sign-in.page.error.provider-prove-a: {provider} has not confirmed that {address} is yours. We have emailed it a code: enter it below, and next time {provider} will sign you straight in.
core.sign-in.page.terms.before: By creating an account you agree to our
core.welcome.title: Welcome
core.welcome.signed-in-as: You're signed in as {address}. What should we call you? It goes on your tickets and on anything the theatre sends you.
core.welcome.ask: What should we call you? It goes on your tickets and on anything the theatre sends you.
core.welcome.name: Your name
core.passkey-offer.title: Add a passkey
core.passkey-offer.description: A passkey lets you sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock instead of waiting for an email.
core.passkey-offer.console-needs: You will need a passkey to use the console.
core.link-landing.title: Sign in
core.link-landing.press: Press Sign in to finish signing in from your email.
core.verify-address.title: Confirm your address
core.verify-address.done: Your address is confirmed. You can close this page.
core.verify-address.new-link: Send a new link from your account
core.verify-address.press: Press Confirm address to finish adding it to your account.
core.confirm-erasure.title: Confirm erasure
core.confirm-erasure.done: Your erasure is confirmed. It will run on or after {date}. Until then you can cancel it from your account.
core.confirm-erasure.held: Something needs to be settled first. Your account shows what it is.
core.confirm-erasure.see: See the request in your account
core.confirm-erasure.press: Press Confirm erasure to confirm that you want your account erased.
core.setup.title: Set up your theatre
core.setup.step-owner: Step 1 of 2. You will be the first Owner. Owners can do everything, so you will sign in with a passkey.
core.setup.step-theatre: Step 2 of 2. About the theatre. You can change any of this later under Admin.
core.setup.theatre-name-help: Shown in the site's header, on emails and in page titles.
core.setup.time-zone-place: Where the theatre is. Performance times, dates and scheduled work follow it.
core.setup.contact-help: A shared address the public can write to, such as boxoffice@example.org, not your own. Leave it empty to add it later.
core.setup.no-email.title: Nothing is emailed yet
core.setup.no-email.description: Until a sending domain is verified in Admin, under Email sending, the site sends no email, sign-in links included. Your passkey and recovery codes are how you get in until then.
core.setup.passkey-explained: A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock instead of a password. If this device cannot make one, your browser offers to use your phone.
core.recovery-codes.title: Your recovery codes
core.recovery-codes.left: Each one works once, if you lose your passkey. {count} codes are left; used codes are struck through.
core.recovery-codes.left.one: Each one works once, if you lose your passkey. 1 code is left; used codes are struck through.
core.recovery-codes.keep: Keep these somewhere safe, such as your password manager. Each one works once, if you lose your passkey. You can see them again from Signing in, after confirming it is you.
core.recovery-codes.not-copied: Your browser did not allow copying. Download the codes instead.
core.recovery-codes.saved: I have saved these codes somewhere safe
core.recovery-codes.take-first: Download or copy the codes first.
core.recovery-codes.tick: Tick this once you have saved them.
core.recovery-codes.file.heading: {site}: recovery codes
core.recovery-codes.file.saved: Saved {date}. Each code works once, if you lose your passkey.
core.recovery-codes.file.name: recovery-codes
core.welcome.under-18-help: We keep only the day you turn 18, never your date of birth, and forget it once it comes.
